question: If I own the creature that Exhumer Thrull is haunting, can that creature be targeted by the haunt trigger returning a creature card to my hand?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: that creature will generally be a legal target for the haunt trigger.
expected.answer: If you own the creature Exhumer Thrull was haunting, that creature will generally be a legal target for the haunt trigger to return to your hand.

whyHard: The haunted creature has just died, and players forget it is in the graveyard by the time the trigger resolves.
